title: FEWER GUNS IN LOOT
why: His order: fewer guns in loot. Every gun row in the locker, safe, body, jackpot and cache loot tables now keeps half its old weight and gives the other half to other loot the table already holds, so the table totals and the seeded stream do not move.
now: Guns turn up about half as often in containers and on bodies; other loot takes their place.
